items.quote: It's not like experience or skills which will determine your success in real estate. It's a personality traits.
items.statement: Success in real estate is determined by personality traits rather than experience or skills.

items.quote: You should be able to do hard things for a long time, like cold calling or following up.
items.statement: You should be able to do hard things for a long time, like cold calling or following up.

items.quote: You should be curious, not to assume things about the client, but ask the right questions.
items.statement: Be curious and ask the right questions about the client instead of making assumptions.

items.quote: So instead of chasing the next shiny object, strengthen your basics.
items.statement: Strengthen your basics instead of chasing the next shiny object.
